notes: Modified cash basis school district; fund balance = cash. Basic statement receipts/disbursements/beginning/ending from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp3-4). Re-check (attempt 2, 2026-10-28): State receipts 32,524,481 split with split_from using the fund schedules (General p7, Special Building p17, QCPU p18, Nutrition p15, Cooperative p19): Homestead Exemption 1,288,077, Property Tax Credit 10,989,385 (both also printed on p1), Nameplate Capacity Tax 120,194, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 85,341, remainder state aid 20,041,484. Other local receipts 310,954 split (General p7 + Student Fee p20 + Cooperative p19 breakdown): Tuition Received 59,829, Extracurricular Receipts 151,438, remainder 99,687 Tuition Received (dominant: postsecondary 45,889 + summer school fees 6,545 = 52,434; rest license fees, community service, rentals; marked review). Statement 'Operation of non-instructional services' 400,000 (= 3300 Community service operations, p10) is Community Service Operations. Detail: 1200/1291/1292/1295 special education -> Special Education Programs; 2410/2490 -> School Administration; 3300 -> Community Service Operations; 1800 Community Service Activities -> charges for services; 1910 Rentals -> Rentals; Nutrition 1620 non-reimbursable daily sales -> School Lunch Sales (attempt 3, 2026-10-28 verifier fixes). Balance sheet now from the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances (p5, Total Governmental Funds column; totals 40,941,367 equal the government-wide p2 figures), fund balance by classification. Nutrition Fund is reported within Other Governmental Funds, so recorded as governmental; business_type null. Component unit (Norfolk Public Schools Foundation) skipped. Detail: General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (pp7-11) used instead of the p6 General Fund components combining schedule (cut off after General administration; not double counted). That budget schedule's total disbursements 59,478,250 include 1,110,228 of transfers to the Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (note p21; General fund components 59,478,250 + 958,500 + 257 - 1,110,228 = 59,326,779 on the statement). General Fund lines 8000 Transfers out (budget 500,000) and Reappropriated funds (budget 8,693,163) and Nutrition 5200 transfers (budget 500,000) have no actual and are omitted. State categorical (3500) and federal (6000) program lines follow the schedule's own headings. Special Building spending is shown by the statement under Operation and maintenance of plant, so category Building and Grounds. Student Fee Fund printed no expenditure total, so none recorded. Activities fund schedule is a one-line budget schedule per fund, no per-account activity schedule. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
